entries.description: They eat once a day
entries.subject: They

spans.text: They eat once a day, once every second day, up to once a week, and so on, even up to once a fortnight.

entries.description: They eat herbs
entries.subject: They

spans.text: They eat herbs, millet, wild rice, poor rice, water lettuce, rice bran, scum from boiling rice, sesame flour, grass, or cow dung.

entries.description: They survive on forest roots and fruits
entries.subject: They

spans.text: They survive on forest roots and fruits, or eating fallen fruit.
